# Low Quality Image Maker

## Quick Facts
- Free online tool to degrade, compress, pixelate, and deep fry images
- 100% client-side processing — images never leave the device
- Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP up to 100MB
- URL: https://low-quality-image-maker.com

## What It Does
Intentionally degrades image quality via: JPEG quality compression (1-100%), pixelation (1x-20x), noise overlay, blur, brightness shift, and preset effects (Nuked, Classic Deep Fried, Light Fry, CRT Monitor, 2003 Phone). Includes target file size auto-match for government forms, Discord uploads, and email attachments.

## Key Pages
- Home (tool): https://low-quality-image-maker.com/

## Presets
| Preset | Quality | Pixelation | Noise | Brightness | Use Case |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|------------|----------|
| Light Fry | 30% | 1x | 0% | 0 | Subtle compression |
| Classic Deep Fried | 20% | 2x | 15% | +5 | Standard Reddit meme |
| Nuked | 10% | 8x | 35% | +20 | Maximum crust |
| 2003 Phone | 20% | 6x | 20% | -5 | Vintage cameraphone |
| CRT Monitor | 40% | 1x | 8% | -10 | 90s monitor effect |

## Output Formats
JPEG (best for compression), PNG (lossless, transparency), WebP (modern balance)
